hints.title: Wildcard Projection
hints.text: Replacing the character at index j with a wildcard character generates an equivalence key.

hints.title: Position-by-Position Hashing
hints.text: For each character position j from 0 to m - 1, remove character j from every word and check for collisions.

hints.title: Early Exit Collision Detection
hints.text: If a wildcard pattern has already been observed in the current position set, return true immediately.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of strings in dictionary
complexity.notes: Iterates through M character positions, checking set collisions across all N strings.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of strings explicitly takes O(N^2 * M) time, exceeding limits for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Wildcard masking per position uses O(N * M) auxiliary set memory for linear pair comparisons.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Position-by-position mask generation or rolling polynomial hashing.
